title: Completed execution of a statement
statement: Fix a word size $W$, compiler setting $S$, statement $s$, resulting state $\sigma'$, natural numbers $c,\mathrm{pos},q$, and memory maps $m,m'$. A completed execution consists of a run of the compiled code from position $\mathrm{pos}$ to the position immediately after its code, taking $n$ machine steps with $n\leq 2\,\mathrm{disp}\,c$; the final memory represents $\sigma'$ in the same frame, and cells outside those writable by a statement in frame $q$ are unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A word size $W$ and compiler setting $S$
The final memory represents $\sigma'$ in frame $q$
Memory agrees outside the cells writable by a statement in frame $q$
caveat: The meanings of the run relation, representation relation, and writable-cell set are not defined in the payload.
